# CodieLead

> CodieLead is an AI-assisted B2B prospecting workspace for turning ideal customer profiles into clean, outreach-ready lead lists.

## Product

CodieLead helps sales teams discover businesses, target multiple cities, deduplicate company leads, enrich records, manage campaigns, and prepare cold outreach. Search and ICP scraping use configured AI/search providers and protected server routes; results are not a guarantee of business accuracy.

## Features

- Natural-language ICP and Smart Search
- Multi-city geographic targeting
- Name/domain deduplication scoped to each company
- Lead saving, filtering, scoring, tagging, categories, and Kanban management
- AI enrichment and outreach drafting
- Campaign management
- Spreadsheet-compatible CSV and JSON export
- Subscription, credits, and manual receipt-based InstaPay workflow
- CRM, SMTP, Redis, S3/R2, webhook, and extension integrations where configured
- SuperAdmin platform controls with privileged authorization

## Architecture

The frontend uses Next.js 16 App Router, React, and TypeScript. Route adapters live in `src/app`. A custom Node.js/Express server owns `/api/*` routes and delegates page rendering to Next.js. Drizzle ORM and mysql2 access TiDB/MySQL. Feature entrypoints live in `src/features`; atomic-design entrypoints live in `src/components/ui/{atoms,molecules,organisms}`. The application is designed to remain stateless for horizontal scaling.

## Public routes

`/`, `/login`, `/register`, `/accept-invite`, `/privacy`, and `/terms` are public or tokenized routes. `/app` requires authentication. `/superadmin` requires SuperAdmin authorization.

## Current verification

The repository currently has 55 passing Vitest tests across 10 files, passing ESLint CLI, strict TypeScript, E2E HTTP smoke, production build, and a production-only high-severity dependency audit with zero high-severity findings. Full browser E2E, staging rehearsal, backup/restore, observability, and load testing remain release gates.
